Replace sign-in client golden-web (Golden): Rovara users sign in to it from a terminal (a loopback redirect, as agentx login uses), and it gets tokens addressed to golden-web, which AgentX's developer API accepts only on the routes its scopes open. Its people stay signed in until they next refresh, which then follows these settings. As the signed-in person, and within their own rights, it may: projects:members.
